arguments.command:
set -eu
BASE=/home/storage/781/4477781/user/webapp
echo '--- ENV_FILE ---'
sha256sum "$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"
grep -E '^export OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL|CONTEXT_LENGTH)=' "$BASE/ollama-runtime.env"
echo '--- RELEVANT_CRON ---'
(crontab -l 2>/dev/null || true) | grep -nE 'ollama-keepalive|warm-residency|concurrency-ledger-service' || true
echo '--- DAEMON_EFFECTIVE ---'
pid="$(pgrep -f "$BASE/miniconda/bin/ollama serve" | head -n1 || true)"
echo "PID=$pid"
if [ -n "$pid" ]; then tr '\0' '\n' < "/proc/$pid/environ" | grep -E '^OLLAMA_(KEEP_ALIVE|MAX_LOADED_MODELS|NUM_PARALLEL|CONTEXT_LENGTH)=' | sort || true; fi
echo '--- API_PS ---'
curl -fsS --max-time 5 http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/ps; echo
echo '--- BOUNDED_RESIDENCY_CHECKPOINTS ---'
find "$BASE/checkpoints" "$BASE/backups" -maxdepth 1 -type d -name '*bounded*residency*' -print 2>/dev/null | sort | tail -20
